title: Execution of a safe straight-line block
statement: For any statement $s$, initial state $\sigma$, cost bound $T$, and state predicate $Q$, if $s$ is block-safe from $\sigma$, its block cost is at most $T$, and $Q$ holds of the state obtained by applying $s$'s prescribed state transformation to $\sigma$, then $s$ has an execution from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The block cost of $s$ is at most $T$
$Q$ holds of the state obtained by applying $s$'s prescribed state transformation to $\sigma$
